name: NxtGen
tagline: Indian sovereign cloud, data center and colocation for enterprises
description: NxtGen is a Bengaluru-based enterprise cloud and data center provider offering colocation, sovereign IaaS cloud, disaster recovery and AI infrastructure — quote-based, not a budget shared host.
about: NxtGen (NxtGen Datacenter & Cloud Technologies) is an India-based provider founded in Bengaluru, running high-density data center (HDDC) facilities across multiple campuses in the Bengaluru region engineered to exceed Tier III specifications, with capacity for up to roughly 2,000 high-density racks. Its business spans colocation and dedicated hosting, enterprise cloud infrastructure-as-a-service (branded Elastic Cloud Services / SpeedCloud), disaster recovery and business continuity, managed security, CDN, and — more recently — AI infrastructure services, positioning itself as a sovereign alternative to global hyperscalers for Indian and regional enterprises that need data to stay within Indian jurisdiction.

NxtGen does not publish fixed retail pricing for most of its offerings — colocation, dedicated racks and its higher-tier cloud services are quote-based, scoped to a customer's vCPU, RAM, storage, networking and rack-density requirements. Its entry-level Elastic Cloud IaaS is referenced by resell partners starting around ₹4,999/month, with cloud deployments claimed in as little as 48 hours, but final pricing depends on configuration and is arranged directly with NxtGen's sales team rather than through self-serve checkout.

As an enterprise/B2B infrastructure vendor, NxtGen is not comparable to consumer shared-hosting brands — there are no shared hosting plans, website builders or one-click WordPress installs. It's aimed at businesses needing colocation space, dedicated infrastructure, or a compliant cloud alternative to AWS/Azure/GCP for regulated or data-residency-sensitive workloads.
policies: NxtGen's cloud and colocation contracts are enterprise agreements arranged per customer rather than a standard consumer refund/cancellation policy — pricing, minimum commitment terms and SLAs are negotiated directly with NxtGen's sales team, so check the specific contract terms before signing rather than assuming a fixed-term or money-back structure.
